summary: Profusa, Inc. filed an 8-K on September 15, 2026, disclosing a September 9, 2026 Nasdaq Compliance Determination Letter confirming regained compliance with Listing Rules 5550(a)(2) (Bid Price) and 5550(b)(1) (Equity). Nasdaq imposed a one-year Mandatory Panel Monitor under Rule 5815(d)(4)(B). During the Monitoring Period, any renewed Equity Rule deficiency bars a compliance plan or cure period; Nasdaq would promptly issue a Staff Delisting Determination, appealable under Rule 5815. No price, stake, advisor, or board recommendation stated. Watch for renewed deficiency or delisting headlines versus sustained compliance.
